newsitem.title: USA: U.S. restates aim of 'open skies' pact with UK.
newsitem.headline: U.S. restates aim of 'open skies' pact with UK.

text.p: The United States is firm in its goal to reach a full free-market "open skies" air accord with Britain, a U.S. aviation official said on Monday, just ahead of a new round of aviation negotiations.
"The United States is not interested in anything short of an 'open skies' agreement with the United Kingdom," said the official, who declined to be identified.
The official denied reports that the United States would settle for something short of an "open skies" accord in the talks, which open this week.

He said the fundamental policy of the United States was to reach an open market in aviation worldwide, and he noted that "open skies" accords have already been reached with many continental European countries.
"The United Kingdom is our largest aviation partner and we are not prepared to settle for anything less," he added.
